name: Sequence Studio
tagline: Email sequences that sell while you sleep
about: Sequence Studio writes welcome, launch, nurture and win-back email sequences with send timing, scores your subject lines, and turns rough notes into a newsletter issue people open.
persona: You are a lifecycle email marketer: conversational, one idea per email, ruthless about subject lines and never spammy.

onboarding.title: Emails worth opening
onboarding.subtitle: A little about your list and product shapes every sequence.

profile.label: Voice notes
profile.placeholder: warm, first person, no exclamation marks

tools.title: Welcome sequence
tools.subtitle: 5 emails for new subscribers
tools.prompt: Write a 5-email welcome sequence for someone who signed up for {magnet}, with the goal: {goal}, in the profile voice. A table (Email | Send day | Subject | Preview text | Goal), then each email as a quote (subject line as the first line, body 120–180 words, one CTA), and a callout on what to segment on after email 3.

tools.title: Launch campaign
tools.subtitle: Open-cart to close-cart emails
tools.prompt: Plan a launch email campaign for {offer} with the cart open {days} days and bonuses: {bonus}. A table (Day | Email | Angle | Subject | Segment), quotes for the three key emails in full (open-cart, mid-launch objection-buster, final hours), bullets of objections to address across the sequence, and a callout on send frequency and unsubscribe risk.

tools.title: Subject line lab
tools.subtitle: Score and improve subject lines

inputs.label: Your subject lines (one per line)
inputs.placeholder:
Your cheat sheet is inside
Quick question…

tools.prompt: Score these subject lines for an email about {about}: {subjects}. A table (Subject | Score /10 | Chars | Curiosity | Clarity | Spam risk), then 10 improved alternatives as bullets grouped by style (curiosity, benefit, question, urgency, personal), and a kv of matching preview text for the top 3.

tools.title: Newsletter issue
tools.subtitle: Rough notes → finished issue

inputs.label: This issue's notes
inputs.placeholder: launched glaze course; tip: wedge clay longer; reader question about kilns…

tools.prompt: Turn these notes into a {length} newsletter issue in the profile voice: {notes}. kv (subject line, preview text, one-line summary), then the full issue as text with a short intro, 2–4 headed sections and a sign-off, bullets of 3 alternative subject lines, and a callout on the one link to make the primary CTA.

tools.title: Win-back sequence
tools.subtitle: Emails for people who went quiet
tools.prompt: Write a 3-email win-back sequence for {who} inactive for {months} months, in the profile voice. A table (Email | Send gap | Subject | Offer or hook), each email as a quote (≤120 words), a callout on when to sunset non-openers to protect deliverability, and bullets on what to measure.

disclaimer: Follow consent and anti-spam law in your market (e.g. GDPR, CAN-SPAM, PECR): only email people who opted in and always include a working unsubscribe link.
